purpose: select L or A and later select a safe SFT checkpoint for rule-based RL

architecture_arms.L: vision frozen; projector frozen; language LoRA r16
architecture_arms.A: vision frozen; projector fully trainable; language LoRA r16

checkpoint_funnel.pathmmu_candidate_rule: within 1.0 percentage point of that arm-and-seed's best checkpoint
checkpoint_funnel.mmmu_threshold_basis: rescored Base 56.90 minus 7.00 percentage points; panel is only 116 cases

choose_A_only_if_all: PathMMU advantage A minus L is at least 2.0 percentage points on seed 42
A is not more than 1.0 percentage point worse than L on PathVQA retention
A is not more than 1.0 percentage point worse than L on MMMU retention
A is not more than 1.0 percentage point worse than L on delta_vision
architecture_decision.otherwise: choose L as the lower-drift RL starting architecture

formal_sft_to_rl_checkpoint_selection.applies_after: selected architecture is retrained on the fixed SFT3000 split
formal_sft_to_rl_checkpoint_selection.selection_priority: pass SFT generalization filters, then maximize mixed groups and reward variance while avoiding extreme mean pass rate

formal_rl_policy.vision: freeze the selected SFT vision state
formal_rl_policy.projector: freeze the selected SFT projector state
formal_rl_policy.language: train LoRA with rule-based accuracy and format rewards
